templates.name: Leg Press
templates.description: Push a weighted sled away from you with your legs while seated. Targets the quads and glutes with the back supported.
mistakes: Don't lock out your knees at the top
Keep your lower back pressed flat against the pad
Don't let your knees cave inward

templates.name: Lat Pulldown
templates.description: Pull a wide bar down to your upper chest while seated. Builds back width and works the biceps.
mistakes: Don't lean way back to muscle the weight down
Pull to your upper chest, not behind your neck
Drive your elbows down rather than just bending your arms

templates.name: Chest Press
templates.description: Push two handles forward from a seated position. A controlled way to load the chest, shoulders, and triceps.
mistakes: Don't fully lock out your elbows at the top
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back into the pad
Avoid bouncing the weight at the bottom

templates.name: Seated Row
templates.description: Pull a cable handle toward your torso while seated, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the end.
mistakes: Don't round your back as you reach forward
Pull with your back, not just your arms
Don't lean back excessively to use momentum

templates.name: Leg Extension
templates.description: Straighten your legs against a padded arm to isolate the quadriceps.
mistakes: Don't swing or kick the weight up
Pause briefly at full extension
Keep your back flat against the pad

templates.name: Leg Curl
templates.description: Curl your lower legs back against a padded arm to target the hamstrings.
mistakes: Don't lift your hips off the bench
Control the weight on the way down — no dropping
Avoid using momentum to start the curl

templates.name: Shoulder Press
templates.description: Press handles overhead from shoulder height. Builds the deltoids with back support.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back to push the weight up
Keep your core tight throughout
Lower under control — don't let it drop

templates.name: Dip / Chin Assist
templates.description: Assisted dip or chin-up using a counterweight pad to support some of your bodyweight.
mistakes: Use the lowest assistance you can manage
Go through the full range — no half reps
Don't kip or swing your legs

templates.name: Cable Upright Row
templates.description: Pull a cable bar straight up the front of your body to about chin height. Hits the side delts and traps.
mistakes: Don't pull above chin level — it stresses the shoulders
Lead with your elbows, keeping them above your wrists
Don't shrug excessively at the top

templates.name: Cable Bicep Curl
templates.description: Curl a cable bar or rope from down by your sides up to your shoulders. Constant tension on the biceps through the full range.
mistakes: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides
Don't swing your torso to lift
Control the lowering phase — don't drop the weight

templates.name: Cable Crossover
templates.description: Bring two cable handles together in front of your chest from a high pulley. Isolates the chest with constant cable tension.
mistakes: Keep a slight bend in your elbows the whole time
Don't shrug — keep shoulders down
Move through the full range slowly

templates.name: Pec Deck
templates.description: Squeeze two padded arms together in front of you to isolate the chest from a seated position.
mistakes: Don't let your shoulders roll forward
Squeeze and pause briefly at the center
Avoid going too wide at the start — protect the shoulder

templates.name: Back Squat
templates.description: Squat with a barbell across your upper back. The headline lower-body lift — builds quads, glutes, and core stability.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward
Keep chest up and your back in a neutral arch
Hit at least parallel — don't half-rep

templates.name: Bench Press
templates.description: Press a barbell off your chest while lying on a bench. The classic upper-body strength lift.
mistakes: Don't bounce the bar off your chest
Keep wrists straight, stacked over elbows
Plant your feet firmly and use leg drive

templates.name: Deadlift
templates.description: Lift a barbell from the floor to standing. Hits the entire posterior chain — back, glutes, hamstrings.
mistakes: Keep the bar close to your body the whole way up
Don't round your lower back
Engage your lats before you start the pull

templates.name: Bicep Curl
templates.description: Curl dumbbells from your sides up to your shoulders. The simplest bicep isolation.
mistakes: Don't swing your body to lift heavier
Keep elbows pinned to your sides
Control the lowering phase, don't drop

templates.name: Overhead Press
templates.description: Press dumbbells from shoulder height up overhead. Targets the deltoids and triceps with free weights.
mistakes: Don't arch your back excessively to push
Keep your core tight throughout
Press straight up, not forward

templates.name: Pushup
templates.description: Bodyweight chest exercise. Lower your chest to the ground and push back up while holding a plank.
mistakes: Keep a straight line from head to heels
Lower all the way down, not just halfway
Don't let your hips sag or pike up

templates.name: Pullup
templates.description: Pull yourself up so your chin clears a bar. Hard but the gold standard for lats and biceps.
mistakes: Use the full range — start from a dead hang
Don't kip or swing your legs
Engage your shoulders before you pull

templates.name: Situp
templates.description: Sit up from lying flat to work the abdominal wall.
mistakes: Don't yank on your neck with your hands
Use your abs, not momentum
Anchor your feet only if you can't keep them down

templates.name: Lunge
templates.description: Step forward and lower until both knees bend roughly 90 degrees. Works one leg at a time.
mistakes: Don't let your front knee drift past your toes
Keep your torso upright, not leaning forward
Push through your front heel coming up

templates.name: Tricep Pushdown
templates.description: Push a cable bar down with your arms while keeping your elbows fixed. Isolates the triceps.
mistakes: Keep elbows pinned to your sides
Don't lean forward to push the weight
Get full extension at the bottom

templates.name: Running
templates.description: Outdoor or treadmill running at a sustainable pace.
mistakes: Don't sprint out the gate — settle into a pace you can hold
Land mid-foot, not on your heel
Keep your shoulders relaxed; don't hunch

templates.name: Cycling
templates.description: Steady cycling outdoors or on a stationary bike.
mistakes: Set saddle height so your knee bends slightly at the bottom
Don't grip the bars too hard — keep arms relaxed
Maintain a steady cadence rather than mashing the pedals

templates.name: Rowing
templates.description: Indoor rowing machine — full-body steady cardio.
mistakes: Drive with your legs first, then hinge, then pull
Don't yank with the arms; the legs do most of the work
Keep your back tall, not rounded

templates.name: Plank
templates.description: Hold a straight-line plank from forearms or hands. Tracked by how long you can hold it.
mistakes: Don't let your hips sag toward the ground
Don't pike your hips up either — keep one straight line
Brace your core; don't just hang in the position

templates.name: Hip Thrust
templates.description: Drive your hips up against a load while your upper back rests on a bench. The big direct glute lift.
mistakes: Don't hyperextend your lower back at the top
Tuck your chin and ribs — keep a neutral spine
Drive through your heels, not your toes

templates.name: Romanian Deadlift
templates.description: Hinge at the hips with a slight knee bend, lowering a barbell along your legs to mid-shin or so.
mistakes: Don't round your lower back — keep it flat
Hinge at the hips, don't squat the weight down
Don't bounce or jerk at the bottom

templates.name: Calf Raise
templates.description: Push up onto the balls of your feet against a load — standing or seated. Direct calf work.
mistakes: Use full range — drop the heel below level, rise all the way up
Don't bounce — pause briefly at the top
Don't bend the knee mid-rep on a standing variant

templates.name: Lateral Raise
templates.description: Raise dumbbells out to your sides up to shoulder height. Side-delt isolation.
mistakes: Don't shrug — keep your traps relaxed
Lead with the elbow, not the hand
Don't swing the weights up with momentum

templates.name: Face Pull
templates.description: Pull a rope toward your face at eye level, flaring your elbows out. Hits rear delts and upper back.
mistakes: Lead with the elbows, not the hands
Pull to your face, not your chest
Keep the weight light — form first

templates.name: Hanging Leg Raise
templates.description: Hang from a bar and raise your legs to parallel (or higher). Lower-ab focused.
mistakes: Don't swing — control both the up and the down
Engage your shoulders before each rep
Lift with your core, not by kicking your legs

templates.name: Jump Rope
templates.description: Steady jump rope. Tracked by minutes of continuous skipping (or by skip count if you prefer).
mistakes: Stay light on your feet — small bounces, not big jumps
Turn the rope with your wrists, not your shoulders
Keep your elbows close to your body
